title: Ambient Japan — 4-hour scenery (candidate index)
notes: Reference-only index after curatorial exclusions. No image copies. Source assets unchanged.

audio.plan: Loop once with a long crossfade to reach ~4 hours. Do not create or modify audio yet.

missingJapan.need: Shinkansen passing through countryside / rice fields — train small in the landscape
missingJapan.notes: Filled by shinkansen.png (viaduct through a misty rice-and-village valley). Fuji pairing still open.

missingJapan.need: Shinkansen with Mount Fuji (classic railway-landscape composition)
missingJapan.notes: We have Fuji (mt_fuji_2, apple_blossoms, acknowledge) but never with a train.

missingJapan.need: One more Shinkansen in seasonal landscape (sakura or tea country)
missingJapan.notes: Optional if the two high-priority Shinkansen images are strong. train_cherry_blossoms already covers local rail + sakura.

missingJapan.need: Kiyomizu-dera hillside / wooden stage overlooking Kyoto
missingJapan.notes: Kyoto pagoda / Higashiyama street is strong; the Kiyomizu veranda view is absent.

missingJapan.need: Byōdō-in Phoenix Hall across the pond (Uji)
Fushimi Inari senbon torii as a landscape tunnel (quiet, not tourist crush)
Tōdai-ji Great Buddha Hall as a wide architectural landscape
missingJapan.notes: nara_deer already shows the hall behind deer — may be enough.

missingJapan.need: Nachi waterfall with the red pagoda (one of Japan’s unique stacked landscapes)
2–3 wide sakura-row / river-tunnel landscapes (not close-up blossoms)
missingJapan.notes: Filled by sakura_river.png (one wide riverside row). Additional tunnels optional.

missingJapan.need: One more Seto Inland Sea / island-sea panorama (optional Matsushima-class)
missingJapan.notes: wink already suggests this; only fill if we want a clearer iconic view.

missingJapan.need: A distant summer festival or fireworks over a river — people small, landscape first
missingJapan.notes: Filled in spirit by matsuri.png (quiet shrine-path stalls) and yatai.png (night riverside stalls). Not a distant fireworks landscape.

missingJapan.need: One quiet Showa/modern-rural cue (vending machine at dusk, rural bus, concrete coast with tetrapods) beautifully integrated
missingJapan.notes: kei truck (car, transport) and wet modern street (patrol) already cover some modern-rural ground.

missingJapan.need: Starry night over flooded rice paddies — Milky Way reflected in tanada
missingJapan.notes: Filled by starlight.png (village and flooded paddies under the Milky Way). Replaces Start Here room_9/hoshi.
